name: Ketaki Mazumdar

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Ketaki Mazumdar is a poet and educationist based in Mumbai, with childhood roots in Kolkata. Her poetry collections include Woodsmoke and Embers and Toasted Orange Embers. In an interview with The Wise Owl, she describes resilience, empathy and healing as concerns that draw her poems together, and close observation of colour and movement as part of her writing practice.

In Kabita Live’s ‘Holding On Letting Go’, grief and uncertainty are met through small acts of attention: flowering trees, an earthen lamp, a river and birdsong. The poem moves between vulnerability and wonder, finding renewal without pretending that loss has disappeared.
